methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $12.0B total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Durin is a pre-seed stage infrastructure and logistics company founded by Ted Feldmann that has raised $3.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a limited comparables universe consisting of one private peer, Watoga Technologies, with no public company comparables available in the sector.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach given data constraints. This method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of pre-seed to subsequent-stage advancement to a $12.0B base value derived from total capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $30.0B. This represents the only quantitative triangulation method supported by available data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $25.5B (low) to $34.5B (high), with a median point of $30.0B. The narrow methodological basis—relying on a single stage-progression calculation and one private peer—represents a material limitation. The absence of public comparables and the reliance on raised capital as a valuation proxy introduce significant uncertainty around appropriate entry multiples and growth trajectory assumptions. Additional data on Durin's operational metrics, revenue run-rate, or market-specific benchmarks would be required to substantiate or adjust this range with greater confidence.
